name: Odisha Government planned Kendujhar data centre
notes: State Electronics and IT Minister Mukesh Mahaling told the Assembly that a data centre will be set up in Keonjhar and Koraput districts; no capacity or site details found.

name: CtrlS Bhubaneswar 1
notes: Greenfield edge data centre at Infocity, Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar; DCD reported construction began May 30, 2023 and the first facility would offer 5 MW, with long-term expansion to a 10-acre campus.

name: Reserve Bank of India / IFTAS Data Centre Bhubaneswar
developer: Indian Financial Technology and Allied Services / Reserve Bank of India
notes: IFTAS, an RBI subsidiary, awarded a Rs 169 crore contract for a greenfield Bhubaneswar data centre complex; 2026 reports describe the high-security RBI facility at Info Valley-II, Khordha, and Uptime lists a Tier certification for RBI Data Centre Bhubaneswar.

name: Zoho Khurda Data Centre
notes: Odisha SLSWCA approved Zoho Corporation's Rs 306.50 crore data centre proposal in Khurda.

name: Adani Info Valley Bhubaneswar Data Centre
notes: Adani announced an Rs 800 crore data centre at Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, expected to support AI, cloud computing and digital governance and generate about 200 jobs.

name: Odisha State Data Centre 2.0
notes: Odisha Cabinet approved OSDC 2.0 at Rs 266.48 crore as a Tier-III compliant secure and scalable facility, replacing or expanding the constrained state data centre that has operated since 2011.

name: HCLTech Odisha Sovereign AI Park Data Centre
developer: HCLTech with Sarvam AI and Government of Odisha
notes: HCLTech official release says it plans to set up its first AI Data Center in the upcoming Odisha Sovereign AI Park in Bhubaneswar; reported planned capital outlay is Rs 14,257 crore including state financial assistance.

name: Odisha Government planned Koraput data centre
notes: State Electronics and IT Minister Mukesh Mahaling told the Assembly that a data centre will be set up in Keonjhar and Koraput districts; no capacity or site details found.
